entries.reason: Event pumping and main-thread posting expose one capability, dispatch one listener interface and bind one script class; the boundary is recorded so the next provider or consumer must declare itself.
emits: poll notifications delivered through PlatformEvent::subscribePoll; subscribers run on the pump thread and outside the message lock.
binds: eve.PlatformEvent (getName, pump, poll, pollData, getLastData, pushData)
entries.thread_affinity: Platform pump thread for pumping, main thread for IMainThreadPost delivery; sinks run on the pump thread affinity

trim.absent_profile: Headless profiles that omit platform_event keep IMainThreadPost unbound; postings then run inline or are rejected as Unsupported instead of being queued
